title: Ring network on white

techniques.name: Node ring

weight.label: Line weight
weight.note: Weight of every line the figure draws, as a multiple of its own.

mark.label: Mark size
mark.note: Size of every dot and pixel mark the figure lays down (marks up to 6 px across).

ink.label: Ink strength
ink.note: Every transparency the figure uses, multiplied: below 1 thins the inks, above 1 builds them toward solid.

moment.label: Moment
moment.note: Where in its motion the figure is shown, in seconds from the start of its clock.

techniques.implementation: Points on a ring are joined to their neighbors by straight edges; the edge count makes the weight of the ring. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
